content: 4) Massively multilingual pretrained encoders such as m-bert BIBREF29 and xlm-100 BIBREF30 fare quite poorly on our benchmark, whereas pretrained encoders dedicated to a single language are more competitive with static word embeddings such as fastText BIBREF31. Moreover, for language-specific encoders, parameter reduction techniques reduce performance only marginally.
